cards.title: The scarcity is at module level
cards.description: Generic SAP profiles are easy to find. An FICO specialist with S/4HANA migration experience who can start next month is not. Most agencies search on the job title and hand you the mismatch.

cards.title: Unscreened CVs move the work to you

valueProposition.headline: AI-powered matching, human screening, one shortlist
valueProposition.body:
Our matching searches a network across 24 countries on module, seniority and actual start date — not on job title alone. Our recruiters then screen and qualify every candidate before the profile reaches you.

What you receive is a short list of people who fit and are genuinely available, not a stack of CVs to triage. Shortlist, interviews and contract management run through a single platform, for both permanent and interim engagements.

graphic.alt: Recruiter search interface showing matched candidate profiles

process.headline: From requirement to shortlist in four steps

steps.title: Share the requirement
steps.description: Module, seniority, start date, location and engagement type. A short call is enough — no lengthy intake form before we start looking.

steps.title: AI-powered matching
steps.description: We search our network across 24 countries for professionals who fit the module specification and are actually available on your start date.

steps.title: Screened by our recruiters
steps.description: Every candidate is sourced, screened and qualified before reaching your shortlist. Only serious matches — quality over quantity.

steps.title: Interviews, contract and onboarding
steps.description: You interview the shortlist; we handle engagement type, compliance and onboarding — interim, contract or permanent.

ctaSection.headline: Which SAP role needs filling?
ctaSection.subheadline: Tell us the module and the start date in a 30-minute call. You will hear which profiles are available, on what timeline, and an indicative rate range — no obligation.

items.question: Which SAP modules do you cover?
items.answer: FICO, ABAP, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, BTP, Concur, IBP, SD and MM, among others — plus role-based profiles such as SAP project manager, architect, project lead and business analyst. If your module is not listed, put the requirement to us: the network is broader than this list.

items.question: What does an SAP consultant cost per hour?
items.answer: Hourly rates depend on the module, seniority and engagement type — a senior S/4HANA migration architect and a support-level SD consultant are not comparable. In the first call you get an indicative range for your specific role, so you can check it internally before any profiles are shared.

items.question: Permanent or interim?
items.answer: Both. We place SAP professionals on permanent contracts, on our own payroll for interim engagements, and as independent contractors for defined scopes of work. Which structure fits depends on the length and nature of the engagement, and we advise on that.

items.question: How quickly can someone start?
items.answer: It depends on the module and seniority. Because we match on availability rather than profile alone, you get a realistic timeline in the first conversation instead of a commitment that does not survive contact with the candidate's notice period.

items.question: Do you only recruit in the Netherlands?
items.answer: No. GloPros recruits actively across 24 countries in Europe, the Americas and Asia, with recruiters who understand local markets, regulations and talent landscapes. For Dutch enterprises that means a substantially larger pool than the domestic market alone.
